goal: Add a reusable wall-clock deadline primitive in flywheel-core that bounds an awaitable or async-for stream and raises a distinguishable timeout signal within ceiling+epsilon even while the stream is still yielding items.

relevant: packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/loop_guard.py -- the existing hang watchdog keys on inter-message silence; the new primitive is a wall-clock bound, additive not a replacement
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/harness.py -- _invoke_with_watchdog around line 2860 shows the existing silence watchdog the new primitive must NOT duplicate
packages/flywheel-core/tests/test_loop_guard.py -- mirror this test style for the new primitive's tests
references: .flywheel/specs/00066-FEATURE-universal-deadlines.md -- criterion #1 and Decomposition Hint shared invariant
constraints: Place the primitive in a non-pure core module (e.g. a new module or loop_guard); do NOT add it to flywheel_core.task or flywheel_core.lifecycle -- those stay pure (no file/json/io).
Do NOT add a top-level claude_agent_sdk import; the primitive must not require the SDK extra.
The bound is total wall-clock elapsed since the call started -- it must fire even while the wrapped stream is still producing items (not an idle/silence timer).
Add the new pytest target so `uv run pytest -k deadline_primitive` selects it.
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done.
non_goals: Do not weaken, delete, or modify existing assertions in test_loop_guard.py or the harness silence-watchdog tests.
Do not wire any call site (harness/grader/docker/autopilot) to the primitive in this task -- that is the dependent tasks.
Do not introduce the config/default-ceiling resolution here.
edge_cases: An async-for over a generator that yields forever without ever stopping must still raise the timeout signal -- a silence/idle timer that resets on each yield must fail this test.
A coroutine that sleeps past a tiny ceiling raises the same distinguishable timeout signal.
The timeout signal is distinguishable from a normal cancellation so callers can classify it.
